title: Cursor Supply Chain Attack Started at Fireworks AI
description: A supply chain attack began with a compromise of Fireworks AI, where attackers stole an access key and exfiltrated credentials. These credentials were used to push malicious versions of the Anthropic Claude Code extension (versions 2.1.312 and 2.1.313) to the Cursor VS Code Extension Marketplace for about 11 hours. The malicious extensions were served from Cursor's cached marketplace, not from the official Open VSX marketplace. Up to 5,000 users may have been affected. The incident was contained by November 1, and Cursor has not observed further attacker activity since then.
